feature.label: Changelog
feature.description: Configurable changelog lists with permissions, filters, analytics, tags and exports.

ui.changelogFeatureDisabledNotice: The changelog feature is currently disabled.
ui.changelogNoAccess: You do not have access to this changelog.
ui.availableChangelogsText: Open one of the changelogs you can access. Each changelog page stays focused on a single list without sidebars for the others.
ui.noVisibleChangelogsText: No changelog is visible to you yet. Ask an administrator for access or add a direct link later.
ui.selectListToManage: Choose a changelog list to manage entries, columns, access and settings.
ui.changelogAdminSummary: Manage entries, columns, permissions and list settings.
ui.tagSuggestionsHint: These tags are offered in tag dropdowns and can be extended with tags that already exist in entries.
ui.noEntriesText: Create the first entry to start using this changelog.
ui.viewerHint: May open and filter the list.
ui.editorHint: May create entries and edit their own entries.
ui.adminHint: May manage structure, permissions and all entries.
ui.systemColumnsHint: System columns such as creator and updated date are shown automatically and do not need to be created as custom columns.
ui.changelogListAccessDenied: You do not have access to this list.
ui.listSlugInUse: This list slug is already in use.
ui.atLeastOneColumnRequired: At least one column is required.
ui.createEntryDenied: You do not have permission to create entries for this list.
ui.editOwnEntriesOnly: You may only edit your own entries unless you are a changelog admin.
